correctness.rationale: The real harmonic addition theorem identifies rank of evaluation with rank of the positive semidefinite Gegenbauer Gram on n² antipodal representatives, normalized G_n(1)=1. The squared dot-product classes {0,1/4,1/2,1} split the n short and two signed pair coordinates into an m=binom(n,2) difference sector of eigenvalue a=1−x>0, pair-deviation ker(B) sector c=1+3x−4y=15(n−4)(n+4)(n+6)/(16D), a standard (n−1)-copy 2×2 block with determinant 15n(n−3)(n+4)²(n+6)(n+8)/(32D²), and a constant 2×2 block with T11>0 and determinant zero. All zero eigenvalue multiplicities therefore give ranks 6,13,n²−1 exactly. Independent SymPy rational symbolic factorizations checked pair-deviation eigenvalue, standard determinant, constant-sector determinant and weighted null-vector row identity as identities in n; inspected exact-rational verifier verify_b6.py, which additionally forms full small-n Gram ranks. Averaging nonnegative annihilators over the signed-permutation group proves the stated existence thresholds even for non-invariant arrays. Antipodal symmetry is essential for uniqueness because odd weights annihilate even harmonics automatically.

originality.rationale: Bajnok and Nozaki–Sawa develop hyperoctahedral invariant orbit-design equations already giving the invariant short/long sixth-harmonic weight ratio and its positivity threshold; these are correctly treated as known consequences. The non-invariant full n²-row Gram rank, exceptional n=3,4 nullities and uniqueness of all antipodally symmetric degree-six annihilators for n≥5 are stronger and not implied by only invariant moment equations. Long-root-only type-D spectra and abstract harmonic-index bounds concern different configurations or just invariant equations. No direct dominating full mixed-orbit rank located.
residual_risks: The weight ratio and positivity transition are known invariant-theory consequences; not new standalone claims.
An older association-scheme or cubature literature source could already contain the full Gram rank.
Antipode-antisymmetric weight directions give immediate extra zero constraints; uniqueness is only within symmetric weights.

final_claim: For n≥3, exact-degree-six spherical harmonic evaluation on all normalized B_n roots (2n² points, n² projective representatives) has rank 6 for n=3, 13 for n=4 and n²−1 for n≥5. For n≥5 the antipodally symmetric annihilating-weight space is exactly one-dimensional with short weight 16−n and long weight 4; strictly positive weights exist iff n≤15 and nonzero nonnegative iff n≤16 (n≥3).
